flash.reason: Most ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards are sold as 4 MB flash variants; verify with espflash board-info for the specific board.

uf2.reason: Generic ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards do not expose a verified UF2 bootloader by default.

wifi.reason: The ESP32-C3 Super Mini Zephyr reference firmware exposes real ESP32 Wi-Fi management callbacks for SquidScript status, scan, AP start/stop/IP, and volatile-profile station connect/disconnect. Hardware coverage verifies status, scan, redacted network listing, and AP start/stop; station connect tests require explicit credentials.

ble.reason: The ESP32-C3 Super Mini Zephyr reference firmware enables Bluetooth LE for SquidScript BLE file-transfer trigger work. Current hardware coverage verifies BLE advertising; staged chunk receive and install remain tracked runtime work.

GPIO0.reason: Commonly exposed on ESP32-C3 Super Mini headers as a general GPIO and ADC-capable pin.

GPIO1.reason: Commonly exposed on ESP32-C3 Super Mini headers as a general GPIO and ADC-capable pin.

GPIO2.reason: Commonly broken out on ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards, but participates in ESP32-C3 boot-mode strapping.

GPIO3.reason: Commonly broken out on ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards, but participates in ESP32-C3 boot-mode strapping.

GPIO4.reason: Commonly exposed as a general GPIO and often labeled as the conventional external SPI clock pin; ESP32-C3 firmware still assigns the peripheral route at runtime.

GPIO5.reason: Commonly exposed as a general GPIO and often labeled as the conventional external SPI MISO pin; ESP32-C3 firmware still assigns the peripheral route at runtime.

GPIO6.reason: Commonly exposed as a general GPIO and often labeled as the conventional external SPI MOSI pin; ESP32-C3 firmware still assigns the peripheral route at runtime.

GPIO7.reason: Commonly exposed as a general GPIO and often labeled as the conventional external SPI CS/SS pin; ESP32-C3 firmware still assigns the peripheral route at runtime.

GPIO8.reason: Common clone-board LED pin; variants may use GPIO2, GPIO7, GPIO9, or omit a controllable user LED.

GPIO9.reason: Common clone-board BOOT button pin. Holding this low during reset enters download mode on typical ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards.

GPIO10.reason: Commonly exposed on ESP32-C3 Super Mini headers as a general GPIO and used by this repository's e-paper bring-up notes as a reset output candidate.

GPIO11.reason: Not present in the common ESP32-C3 Super Mini header layout documented for this target.

GPIO12.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO13.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO14.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO15.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO16.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO17.reason: Reserved for ESP32-C3 SPI flash or internal flash-related signals; not available for app GPIO.

GPIO18.reason: Native USB Serial/JTAG D- for this reference target; app GPIO use can break USB access.

GPIO19.reason: Native USB Serial/JTAG D+ for this reference target; app GPIO use can break USB access.

GPIO20.reason: Commonly exposed as UART RX on some variants; use as GPIO only when UART bridge/debug access is not needed.

GPIO21.reason: Commonly exposed as UART TX on some variants; use as GPIO only when UART bridge/debug access is not needed.

console.uart0.reason: Some ESP32-C3 Super Mini boards use native USB Serial/JTAG; some expose or bridge UART0.

indicator.power_led.reason: Common ESP32-C3 Super Mini power indicator LED is not controlled by a numbered GPIO.

input.boot_button.reason: Common BOOT button is wired to GPIO9, which is also exposed on the header and acts as a boot strapping pin.

control.reset_button.reason: Common RST button pulls the ESP32-C3 enable/reset line and is not a normal GPIO breakout.

display.reason: This reference firmware target exercises headless SquidScript language behavior over serial.

storage.reason: The ESP32-C3 Super Mini reference firmware stores installed SQBC apps in Zephyr's default 4 MB `storage_partition`, mounted as LittleFS at `/sq`. The partition is 192 KiB at offset 0x3b0000 in the current Zephyr `partitions_0x0_default_4M.dtsi` layout. File/library storage is not implemented yet.

input.reason: The ESP32-C3 Super Mini has a BOOT button, but the reference firmware uses serial commands as the primary conformance input harness.

squidscript.reason: This target exercises the initial headless SquidScript VM subset for language-spec conformance. Installed apps and explicit app state load/save/reset use the firmware-owned LittleFS app store.
